newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish FinMin sees no majority for EMU '99 - report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin sees no majority for EMU '99 - report.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said in an interview on Monday that most of his Social Democratic party did not favour membership in Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU) in 1999.
"Most things indicate that the majority does not have that view," Asbrink was quoted by the weekly Veckans Affarer as saying.
In the interview, Asbrink repeated that party leaders would present their views on EMU membership within a few weeks.

He added that the government would announce possible constitutional changes necessary to participate in EMU and its view on the proposal to transfer responsibility for monetary policy from the central bank, the Riksbank, to the government.
